title: Technical Memorandum on the Loadings That Attach to a Re-Rating — Travel Protection Plans
content:
When a Travel Protection Plans certificate is re-rated, what the loadings that attach add to the declared trip cost at the plan's base premium rate is read from the loading lines standing on the certificate's own premium record.

Where the certificate's premium lines carry both an age loading and a destination loading, the loadings that attach add the proportion those lines bear to the base premium already charged.

Where the certificate's premium lines carry one of those two loadings and not the other, the loadings that attach add the plan's destination loading percentage.

Where neither holds, the loadings that attach add nothing.

## The three cases

| Loading lines standing on the certificate | What the loadings that attach add |
| --- | --- |
| Both an age loading and a destination loading | The proportion the age loading line and the destination loading line together bear to the base premium line already charged |
| One of the two, and not the other | The plan's destination loading percentage |
| Neither | Nothing |

## The plan's destination loading percentage

| Plan | Destination loading, per cent |
| --- | --- |
| Trip Basics Essential | 25 |
| Trip Basics Standard | 22 |
| TripGuard Plus | 20 |
| TripGuard Premier | 18 |
| Cancel For Any Reason Elite | 18 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Traveller | 25 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Executive | 20 |

## Read through on hypothetical figures

Suppose the declared trip cost at the plan's base premium rate comes to 450.00 USD.

Both loadings standing: the certificate's premium record carries a base premium line of 300.00 USD, an age loading line of 36.00 USD and a destination loading line of 60.00 USD. Those two loading lines together bear 96.00 USD to a base premium of 300.00 USD, which is 32 per cent of it, so the loadings that attach add 32 per cent and the figure becomes 594.00 USD.

One loading only: on a plan whose destination loading percentage is 20, the loadings that attach add 20 per cent and the figure becomes 540.00 USD. It makes no difference which of the two lines is the one standing.

Neither loading: the loadings that attach add nothing and the figure stands at 450.00 USD.
